newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Weak prices to hit Amplats year earnings.
newsitem.headline: Weak prices to hit Amplats year earnings.

text.p: Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd said on Monday it expected full-year earnings to be down on the previous year, reflecting weak precious metal prices.

The world's biggest platinum producer, reporting a sharp drop in half-year earnings, said dollar prices for platinum, palladium and rhodium had fallen markedly compared with the previous financial year.
"As a result, earnings from associated mining companies for the full year are likely to be below those achieved in 1996," Amplats said in a statement.
"Although the income from diamond investments is expected to improve over last year the group's earnings are expected to be lower than those of 1996."

Amplats added that the a mid-year strike in 1996 at its Rustenburg Platinum Mines Holdings Ltd mine had cost it about 100,000 ounces of platinum in lost production, and it was unlikely that more than 40 percent of this quantity would be made up during the current financial year.
